The Oasis


Negative Motivation: To move beyond past cycles of negativity, codependancy, abandonment, and betrayal.

Positive Motivation: Come together as individuals to create something we could not separately for the purpose of mutual enjoyment, benefit, and improvement through the power of love.

or: Defining the Relationship

On a tropical island in the astral plane somewhere, our souls dance together as one. Let's do them justice in this world.

While we both work on ourselves, create more of our lives, and see more of ourselves realized through our work. Let us come together to create something special in the meanwhile. Something that would not be possible for each of us to do individually.

I see us as two people, not concerned with status, pride, money, or image, who in turn can benefit from building together. I sense our relationship has the potential to be immensely generative and fruitful, should both people abide by the following precepts or presuppositions:

Note

'Parties' herein refers to Jane 'Doe' Warner and Duine Friant

  • Parties agree to love themselves and each other as they are
  • Parties agree to communicate authentically and vulnerably
  • Parties will refrain from making assumptions about each other's intentions and instead be curious
  • Above all else, parties agree to enjoy each other's company, appreciate the little things, and lighten each others loads
